title: bit
description: The unit of informational-spacetime: a carrier (utterance) paired with two witness slots. The four charge phases are the bit's possible states, read from slot occupancy: absurd [F,F] both empty; potential [T,F] token slot filled; active [F,T] claim slot filled; stable [T,T] both filled. Produced by articulate; the freshly marked bit has both slots empty (absurd).
